title: Manager, PM — Collections & Recoveries Agent Servicing
context: Owned the migration of an agent servicing platform for 1,000+ agents in a regulated, data-sensitive environment.
whatIOwned: Migration strategy, decommissioning legacy infrastructure, backlog translation for 350+ workflows, data contracts and API design, prioritization across engineering, operations, risk, and compliance.
decisionsThatMattered: Decomposing 350+ complex workflows into a parallel execution backlog across 6 teams without service disruption

outcome: 1,000+ agents moved to the new platform with zero service disruption. High-risk manual agent actions eliminated, cutting average handle time by roughly 4 minutes per account and manual work by 40%.
